vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-1866: Backlog Sequencer — AI-ranked whole-backlog DAG with a reproducible markdown source of truth

plan.title: Backlog Sequencer — AI-ranked whole-backlog DAG with a reproducible markdown source of truth
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: Panopticon has no surface that shows the ENTIRE open backlog (522 issues for panopticon-cli) sequenced by real impact and explained. The Flywheel ranks reactively by fixed rules (P0–P3 then oldest-first) with no holistic AI evaluation; GitHub priority is thin/undefined; and there is no reproducible, durable plan-of-record. Operators cannot see, at a glance, what the next item is across the whole backlog and why.
narratives.Proposal: Add a Backlog Sequencer: a configurable-model AI role that evaluates the whole open backlog and writes a total ordering (rank + size + importance + condition + dependency DAG) to a repo-tracked, auto-committed markdown source of truth at .pan/backlog/sequence.md. SQLite is a rebuildable cache only. A new dashboard 'Backlog' page renders the sequence as a tiered, filterable ReactFlow+dagre DAG with in-pipeline/PRD/ready signals, condition flags, an operator Ready/Block pickup gate, and an AI-suggested planning-policy field. The sequencer runs three passes (creation/incremental/review); creation/review are chunked map-reduce so they never put all 522 bodies in one prompt; incremental (the default) reads only the prior file + changed bodies and preserves prior order. Preservation/pinning/gate/edge-provenance are enforced in CODE (reconcileSequence + a `pan backlog finalize` step that mirrors `pan plan finalize`), never trusted to the LLM. The sequencer is a project-scoped server-spawned role mirroring the flywheel orchestrator.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Flywheel-executor integration (consuming sequence.md as pickup order, stopping its own P0–P3/oldest-first ranking, the eligibility filter, emergency-promote) — DEFERRED to a follow-up issue (Decision D8 / PRD work-item 9 / FR-14).
- Planning-policy launch-routing by the Flywheel (mapping skip->`pan start --auto`, auto->`pan plan --auto`, interactive->needs-you) — DEFERRED to the same follow-up; this issue only stores, surfaces, and AI-suggests the planning-policy field.
- Debounced delta auto-trigger and periodic review-pass cadence (PRD work-item 11) — DEFERRED; the v1 trigger is the on-demand page button only.
- On-page dependency-edge drawing/editing UI (drag node->node) — DEFERRED; operator edges are hand-authored in sequence.md for now.
- Bidirectional GitHub dependency sync / writing dependency edges back to GitHub — DEFERRED; sequence.md is read-only with respect to the tracker.
- User-facing `pan backlog sequence` CLI verb and bundled `/pan-backlog` skill — DEFERRED; only the internal `pan backlog finalize` write path ships.
- Running a full Opus creation pass over all 522 live issues during the work phase — out of scope; the work agent verifies on fixtures + a representative subset, and the operator triggers the first production pass post-merge.
- 'Over-the-horizon' ghost nodes (faint next-tier preview inside a tier DAG) — DEFERRED (PRD §16).

items.title: sequence.md schema (contracts) + parseSequence/writeSequence in src/lib/backlog/sequence-io.ts

narrative.Action: Define the shared BacklogSequence types/enums in @panctl/contracts (packages/contracts) — SequenceDoc, SequenceNode (issue, rank, size, importance, score, condition, dependsOn, why, rationale?, gate, planningPolicy, pinned), SequenceEdge (from, to, type, source, confidence) with the D7 enums. Implement parseSequence(md): SequenceDoc (parse + validate the fenced ```json block per PRD §6) and writeSequence(projectRoot, doc): void (render the human table + `## Rationale detail` (top tier only) + the fenced JSON block, then call queueAutoCommit from src/lib/pan-dir/auto-commit.ts) in src/lib/backlog/sequence-io.ts. Honor the NFR-5 footprint budget: store each rationale ONCE — a full paragraph only for the active top tier, a one-line `why` (<=140 chars) for everyone. Rebuild packages/contracts after touching it.

A footprint test validates that a 522-node SequenceDoc renders to <= ~65k tokens (rationale stored once + top-tier paragraphs + one-line why)
reconcileSequence — node preservation (pinning + operator gate/planningPolicy verbatim)

narrative.Action: Add reconcileSequence(prior: SequenceDoc, candidate: SequenceDoc): SequenceDoc node-side logic to src/lib/backlog/sequence-io.ts. For in-pipeline (pinned) nodes, carry forward rank/why/rationale verbatim from the prior doc while refreshing live flags/condition from the candidate. For operator-owned fields (gate, operator-set planningPolicy), carry the prior value verbatim — the candidate cannot overwrite an operator override. Non-pinned, non-operator-owned fields take the candidate's new ranking. This makes preservation structural (D3), not dependent on the LLM obeying the prompt.

items.title: reconcileSequence preserves a pinned node's rank, why, and rationale verbatim from the prior doc even when a sibling node's rank changes
reconcileSequence preserves an operator-set gate and operator-set planningPolicy verbatim (a candidate value does not overwrite them)
reconcileSequence updates a pinned node's live flags/condition from the candidate while it preserves the node's rank
A non-pinned node's rank and why come from the candidate (the new ranking applies wherever nothing is pinned)
reconcileSequence — edge provenance & reconciliation (github-ref / operator / ai-inferred)

narrative.Action: Add the edge-side logic to reconcileSequence in src/lib/backlog/sequence-io.ts. Re-derive github-ref edges each pass by parsing issue bodies for '#N' and 'blocked by PAN-N'/'depends on'/'after' references (GitHub exposes no native relations — github.ts:342 getChildIssues returns []). Preserve operator edges (source='operator') verbatim. Recompute ai-inferred edges (carry confidence 0-1). When an ai-inferred edge contradicts a github-ref/operator edge, the authoritative edge stands and the conflict is surfaced (a flag on the edge), never silently applied. Read-only with respect to GitHub (H8).

items.title: Parsing issue bodies (#N / 'blocked by') produces github-ref edges tagged source='github-ref', re-derived each pass
reconcileSequence preserves operator-authored edges (source='operator') verbatim across a re-sequence
When an ai-inferred edge contradicts a github-ref/operator edge, the authoritative edge wins and the conflict is marked (the ai-inferred edge is not applied)
reconcileSequence produces ai-inferred edges that contain a confidence value (0-1) and recomputes them each pass
planBatches — chunked map-reduce partitioning for creation/review passes (NFR-6)

narrative.Action: Add planBatches(issues, batchSize): Batch[] to src/lib/backlog/sequence-io.ts (or a sibling) that partitions the backlog for the creation/review map-reduce. The full passes process one batch at a time against a running shortlist file so the agent never holds all 522 bodies in context (H5/NFR-6). This bead delivers the deterministic, unit-testable chunking logic; the per-batch agent loop is driven by the sequencer prompt (sequencer-prompt bead).

Sequencer brief + prompt-assembly + three passes + condition/planning-policy assignment

narrative.Action: Author docs/backlog-sequencer-brief.md (durable instructions, mirroring docs/flywheel-brief.md) and buildSequencerPrompt(pass, backlog, priorMd, flags): string. Creation/Review assemble per-batch prompts over a running shortlist (uses planBatches; never all bodies in one prompt — NFR-6). Incremental includes the prior sequence.md + only changed bodies and instructs preserving prior order/rationale except where a delta justifies change (FR-3). Ranking weighs urgency + relevancy + unblocking power + reach; GitHub priority and issue age are inputs, never the answer (FR-2). The prompt instructs assigning each issue a condition {ok,needs-refinement,stale} (FR-11) and an AI-suggested planningPolicy {skip,auto,interactive} (FR-17: AI-created/tiny -> non-interactive, big feature -> interactive; urgency tempers). The assignment maps a legacy needs-design/needs-discussion label to planningPolicy='interactive'. The agent's deliverable is a candidate SequenceDoc JSON; its final step runs `pan backlog finalize` (finalize-cmd bead).

items.title: buildSequencerPrompt('creation') produces per-batch prompts against a running shortlist; buildSequencerPrompt('incremental') produces a prompt that contains the prior sequence.md plus only the changed bodies
Given an unchanged backlog, the incremental pass produces an unchanged order (it preserves prior order/rationale unless a delta justifies a change)

The sequencer produces, for every issue, a condition {ok,needs-refinement,stale} and an AI-suggested planningPolicy {skip,auto,interactive} (AI-created/tiny defaults to non-interactive; a big feature defaults to interactive)
For an issue carrying a legacy needs-design/needs-discussion label, the sequencer defaults to planningPolicy='interactive'
buildSequencerPrompt('review') produces a full from-first-principles re-evaluation prompt and the resulting doc records pass='review'
Internal `pan backlog finalize` — reconcile + write + auto-commit + rebuild cache

narrative.Action: Add an internal CLI command `pan backlog finalize` (the deterministic write path the sequencer agent runs as its last step, mirroring `pan plan finalize`). It reads the agent's candidate SequenceDoc + the prior sequence.md, runs reconcileSequence(prior, candidate), writes the canonical .pan/backlog/sequence.md via writeSequence (which queues the auto-commit), records pass + generatedAt, and rebuilds the SQLite backlog_sequence cache. Update the wrapper skill if any flag is documented (skills<->CLI lockstep). The broader user-facing `pan backlog sequence` verb is out of scope (D9).

items.title: `pan backlog finalize` produces the canonical sequence.md from the candidate + prior file (via reconcileSequence) and commits it through queueAutoCommit

POST /api/backlog/sequence/regenerate — spawn the sequencer for a selected pass

narrative.Action: Add POST /api/backlog/sequence/regenerate to routes/backlog.ts. It calls spawnSequencer with the requested pass {incremental, review}. When no sequence.md exists, it defaults to a 'creation' pass regardless of the requested pass (FR-10). It respects the singleton gate (refuse while a run is active). The route only enqueues/spawns; the agent produces the candidate and runs finalize.

POST /api/backlog/sequence/gate — operator pickup gate + planning-policy override (+ parked label)

narrative.Action: Add POST /api/backlog/sequence/gate to routes/backlog.ts. It sets a node's operator-owned pickup gate {auto,ready,blocked} and (same endpoint) an operator planningPolicy override {skip,auto,interactive}, writing through reconcile/writeSequence so the change auto-commits and survives the next re-sequence. Setting gate=blocked applies a parked label (needs-design default from BLOCKER_LABELS, src/lib/cloister/auto-merge-eligibility.ts:10) so the EXISTING Flywheel skip honors it immediately (H10 — the deferred #9 integration is not required for Block to bite); setting gate to auto/ready clears the parked label. No execSync (H3).
